title: Token bucket request admission
summary: Each account receives ten tokens per second with a reserve of twenty. Requests consume one token. The reserve permits short surges while maintaining a long-term traffic ceiling.

title: Window edge double counting
summary: Pods disagree about the current time. A request near a counter boundary can be admitted twice. Use the storage server clock for window assignment.

title: Retry-After header on rejected requests
summary: HTTP 429 responses advertise the number of seconds clients should wait. Clients that ignore this delay amplify overload with repeated attempts.

title: Atomic quota increment
summary: Redis Lua combines reading the quota and incrementing usage in one indivisible operation. Separate read and write calls race under concurrent requests.

title: Session cache expiry policy
summary: The initial session cache retained values for five minutes. This policy has been superseded by a shorter retention window.

title: Session cache expiry policy
summary: The session cache now expires values after thirty seconds. Invalidation on account changes prevents outdated permissions from being served.

title: Coalescing cold cache requests
summary: Simultaneous misses for one key share a single backend fetch. Waiting callers reuse that result instead of independently overloading the database.

title: LRU for interactive session reads
summary: Least recently used eviction retains frequently revisited sessions better than insertion-order eviction. The comparison used repeated interactive navigation traces.

title: Correlation across asynchronous work
summary: Carry a request identifier through queued jobs and child spans. Without it, traces cannot connect a background worker's operation to the initiating request.

title: Sampling rare slow operations
summary: Retain all traces exceeding the latency budget and sample ordinary traffic sparsely. Uniform sampling alone loses uncommon slow requests.

title: Structured logs at decision boundaries
summary: Emit JSON records when choosing an action or returning an error. Logging every loop iteration creates volume without explaining behavior.

title: Composite session index
summary: IDX_SESSION_TIME indexes account_id and created_at in that order. It supports fetching one account's recent sessions without scanning the entire table.

title: Storage cleanup after bulk deletion
summary: Deleted rows leave pages allocated. VACUUM compacts the database and returns unused disk space after a large removal batch.

title: Nonblocking index rollout
summary: Build new indexes concurrently on the production database. Ordinary index creation holds a lock that stops writes until construction completes.

title: Session cache expiry policy
summary: The disposable sandbox keeps session values for two hours because it contains no private account changes. This setting does not apply to the library application.

title: Daily traffic chart
summary: Today's dashboard includes a request admission counter and a traffic chart. It does not specify a quota algorithm.

title: IDX_SESSION_TIME alternate design
summary: Use a single created_at column index across accounts. This experiment was abandoned because per-account reads became slower.

title: Service readiness check
summary: A readiness endpoint returns success only after the configuration is loaded and the database connection is usable. A process being alive alone is insufficient.
